en: Book of the Twos, Chapter on the Bīraṇa Thicket (Bīraṇathambhavagga)
“He constantly applied himself with diligence for a year to the task of making a pillar of *bīraṇa* grass.”
"He explained perception after entering the assembly;
restraint does not protect one of little wisdom.
"There are two things, dear father, for a beggar..."
Soma-datta, one encounters either loss or the gain of wealth;
such indeed are the nature of begging.”
The Somadatta Jātaka is the first.
